narr: A strong to severe storm dropped over five inches of rain in a 2-hour time period on the southeast side of Springfield during the late afternoon. This led to flash flooding along Galloway Creek, and tree damage due to winds estimated in excess of 50 mph.
ev: Several intersections along Battlefield Road had cars stalled in high water.
Several roads were reported as impassable due to high water in the Galloway area.
lsr: Several intersections flooded with stalled cars on East Battlefield Rd.
Greene County OEM reported roads in the Galloway area are impassible due to flooding.
